The event of `onChange` on a field, which fires once its text changed.

## Description

It fires on each real change of the text, whatever its source: typing, a setter, a bound signal or `change(...)`.

## Learn more

- [Controls](/use/learn/interactivity/controls/#react-to-a-change)
- [Text fields](/use/learn/interactivity/text-fields/)
